headline: Linn Mercy Flares as Dead Lands Falls Quiet
war_summary: Latest wires put Linn Mercy to the fore with three changes in two hours and sixteen on the day about Lathair and Rotdust, last reported at 10:43, amid 4,491 Colonial and 7,440 Warden casualties on the day with two-hour losses still accelerating. Dead Lands, lately busiest, has gone quiet with none in two hours after three in six and five on the day about Callahan's Gate, last at 08:25, as hourly casualty rates cool. The Weathered Expanse remains still with none in two after one in six and twenty-two on the day about Crow's Nest and Frostmarch, standing four Warden to five Colonial despite 780 Colonial and 975 Warden losses in two hours. Stonecradle counts none in two after three in six and eleven on the day about World's End, The Dais and The Heir's Knife, though two-hour losses of 827 Colonial and 1,095 Warden are accelerating. Stlican Shelf shows none in two and six after seven on the day about Thornhold and Fort Hoarfrost, and Mooring County none in two and six after eight on the day about Wiccwalk and The Wind Hills. Nevish Line reports 6,056 Colonial and 3,796 Warden casualties on the day but no flips.
